reasons: "New offences cover brokering, financial services and funds linked to gold, precious metals, diamonds and energy-related goods for Iran" is not supported for energy-related goods: the source only shows export and supply bans for those goods (27H, 27I) and cuts off at 27J, with no brokering, financial services or funds offences for them.

proposed_record.title: Wider UK sanctions on Iran covering finance, investment, bonds, gold and energy
proposed_record.summary: Since 29 September 2026, the UK's Iran sanctions include new bans on lending to, investing in and forming joint ventures with Iranian energy and nuclear-linked businesses, and on services that help Iran issue bonds.
what_changes: It is an offence to lend to, take an ownership interest in or form a joint venture with Iran-connected firms in oil, gas, petrochemicals or uranium.
It is an offence to provide brokering, advertising or any other service that helps the Government of Iran or Iranian banks issue bonds.
Insurance and reinsurance for persons connected with Iran is banned, except under agreements made before 8 September 2026.
New offences cover brokering, financial services and funds linked to gold, precious metals, diamonds and energy-related goods for Iran.
proposed_record.who_it_applies_to: Firms acting for companies or clients with dealings connected to Iran, including finance, investment, insurance, commodities and energy work.

history.event: Regulations made on 7 September 2026 and in force from 29 September 2026.
